name: Shyloh
source:
An enigmatic half-sketched pixie from the painting. He yearns for completion to embrace his destiny as a true antagonist and forever stay by the side of his creator. His love reaches the pinnacle of nobility and unconditional devotion.

[From[url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/chromatic-agape] itch.io[/url]]
